entities.summary: Luigi Cossa was a performers & entertainers in Milan (1831-05-22, Milan – 1896-05-10) who made significant contributions during the Modern era. Their work intersected with economic development and trade and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Influenced economic patterns and commercial practices.
